title: Many Optimizers But Only One Training Path: Repeated Resampling for Adaptive Optimizer Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.18810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An optimizer is usually chosen before training a deep neural network and then kept fixed. Treating optimizer choice as a hyperparameter could boost performance, but it requires several complete training runs and discards all but the winner. Repeated Optimizer Resampling (ROR) instead searches during one evolving run. Every $b$ epochs, each candidate optimizer scouts from the current model weights for $s$ epochs. The best scout continues for the remaining $b-s$ epochs, and that completed segment becomes the new incumbent if it improves the validation objective. This design allows the preferred optimizer to change as training progresses.   We compare two variants of ROR on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and two motor insurance claim-count models. Nine fixed optimizers and both ROR variants are evaluated with the same ten seeds. translated_title: 众多优化器但仅有一条训练路径：用于自适应优化器选择的重复重采样
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18810v1 公告类型：新  摘要：在训练深度神经网络之前通常选择一个优化器，并保持固定不变。将优化器选择视为超参数可能会提升性能，但这需要多次完整的训练运行，并仅保留胜出者。重复优化器重采样（ROR）在单次动态运行中搜索。每隔b个周期，每个候选优化器从当前模型权重出发进行s个周期的探索。最佳探索者继续完成剩余的b-s个周期，如果该完整段改善了验证目标，则成为新的现任者。这种设计允许首选优化器随训练进展而变化。我们在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和两个汽车保险索赔计数模型上比较了ROR的两种变体。使用相同的十个随机种子评估了九个固定优化器和两种ROR变体。单周期ROR使用了识别最佳固定优化器所需总训练的24%至35%，从而彻底地重新评估。
tldr: 本论文提出重复优化器重采样（ROR）方法，在单次训练中动态选择优化器，显著减少计算开销，同时保持性能优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Repeated Optimizer Resampling (ROR), which dynamically selects optimizers during a single training run, significantly reducing computational cost while maintaining performance advantages.
